name: error_summary
description:
What's going wrong in this project right now, without writing a query:
error-level log lines grouped by message, and failed spans grouped by
name, each with a count and the most recent occurrence.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: one hour ago.

name: get_trace
description:
Follow one request: the full span tree for a trace id, plus every log
line emitted during it, joined by trace id.

trace_id.description: The trace id to look up.

name: query_logs
description:
Search this project's own deployed logs.

Always bounded by a time window (default: the last hour) and a row cap
(default 100, max 1000) — a capped result says so rather than silently
dropping lines. There is no `service`/`project` parameter: the connection
this tool makes is already scoped to the calling project, and nothing
passed here can widen that.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: one hour ago.

text.description: Substring match against the log message.

trace_id.description: Only logs emitted during this trace.

name: slow_spans
description:
The slowest spans in this project's own traces, without writing a query.

Bounded by a time window (default: the last hour) and a row cap (default
100, max 1000).

min_duration_ms.description: Only spans at or above this duration.

name_like.description: Substring match against the span name.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: one hour ago.
